claims.claim: Scrap power banks for sale in Ibadan.
claims.evidence: Witness only saw two black plastic cylinders with ports and a blue-green cable; no readable power bank branding, labels, or typical power bank form factor.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours.
claims.evidence: No battery capacity/health test, no power-on/load test, and no visible model/ratings on the items in the report.
No internal inspection, no repair marks/serial verification, and no evidence of prior opening in the witness description.

risks.risk: The items may not be power banks at all (could be a different electrical device/part), so the claimed battery/charge behavior may not apply.
risks.proof: A clear shot showing the device type and any readable brand/model/label (front/back/side) plus the ports/connector type in context.
risks.if_unproven: Price as scrap/unknown non-tested electrical items (worst case: non-functional or not as described).

risks.risk: Working condition is unknown (may not power on, may fail under load, or may have degraded cells).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the device powering on and performing a load/charging test (e.g., charging a phone and showing it stays charging for a sustained period).

risks.risk: Battery claim ("holds charge for 8 hours") is not verifiable without a capacity/runtime test.
risks.proof: A timed runtime test clip showing the device fully charged, then powering a known load for the claimed duration (or a meter reading).
risks.if_unproven: Price as scrap with no guaranteed runtime.

risks.risk: Completeness/compatibility risk: missing covers, cells, connectors, or attachments could make it unusable.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides and ends, including any missing parts, plus a shot of the full connector/port area and what accessories are included.

risks.risk: Cable/connection integrity risk: the blue-green cable may be damaged or not original, affecting safety and function.
risks.proof: A close-up of the cable end-to-end (no cuts/frays), and a clip showing stable connection during operation.

proof_requests: Clear photos of the full items (all sides and both ends) with any readable brand/model/ratings label.
A video showing the device powering on/charging a phone (or a proper load) and staying stable.
A timed test showing runtime under a known load (or a meter reading) to support the 8-hour claim.
Close-ups of the ports/connector area and the cable ends to confirm integrity and correct matching.
Photos showing whether any parts are missing (covers/filters/attachments) and what accessories are included.
response.reason: The witness report does not confirm the items are power banks or show any readable identifiers, and working/runtime claims cannot be verified from the described images. Without a proof shot (type/label) and a basic functional test, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
